temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan admits he has been keeping something from Christian and says he is in some trouble, though he has not yet explained the details.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is hiding something important from Christian; Christian feels anxious and suspicious.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jonathan confirms he has been hiding something, but it is that he is in trouble rather than just a vague secret.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is in serious trouble and had been concealing it from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Anxious, suspicious, then worried and concerned.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To learn more about Jonathan's trouble and understand what is going on.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Jonathan says the situation is complicated and he does not want to drag Christian into it; after Christian insists, Jonathan accepts support and resources and says he needs to find a way out.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is in serious trouble and had been hiding it from Christian.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jonathan is willing to accept Christian's help, but the trouble is complicated and he still needs resources and support to resolve it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan needs Christian's support and resources to get out of a complicated mess.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To offer help and support Jonathan in finding a way out.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian asks if the trouble is illegal; Jonathan says he cannot say for sure, might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but denies doing anything illegal himself. Christian says he will look into it discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan's trouble is serious and complicated, and Christian now suspects it may involve criminal activity.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Jonathan admits possible involvement with wrong people while denying personal illegal acts, leaving the criminal connection uncertain but plausible.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan may be entangled with criminals or wrong people, though he claims he did not do anything illegal himself; discreet investigation is needed.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To investigate the matter discreetly to learn the truth and help ensure Jonathan's safety without alarming him.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian's investigation reveals that Jonathan is being framed; he tells Jonathan that someone is trying to set him up, says he has leads, and plans to gather more evidence.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan may be entangled with criminals or wrong people, though he denies illegal acts; Christian is investigating discreetly.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian's investigation shifts his belief from uncertainty about Jonathan's involvement to the conclusion that Jonathan is innocent and is being framed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Jonathan is being framed by someone and is innocent, so evidence must be gathered to clear his name.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Determined, protective, and possibly angry or relieved.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To gather evidence that proves Jonathan's innocence and clears his name.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Christian tells Jonathan he has found out who is behind the frame: it is someone they both know and trust. Jonathan is shocked, and Christian says he will confront the culprit and bring them to justice.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Jonathan is innocent and is being framed; the culprit is still unknown, but Christian has leads.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes: Christian identifies the real culprit as a trusted mutual acquaintance, making the situation a betrayal by someone close to them both.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: A person close to both Christian and Jonathan is the real culprit and deliberately framed Jonathan.
temporal_state_chain.intention: To confront the real culprit and ensure they are brought to justice.
